policy: Source/query/profile identities, context, support/masks, values, statuses, global ranks/universes and series order exact. Metadata ID sets canonicalized. CSV text/order exact, numeric Float64 exact. Profile download bodies compared by native raw SHA, including gzip-decoded bytes; all profile download HEADs require exact entity Content-Length; GET may be chunked/missing Content-Length, but any supplied length and every actual body byte count/SHA are exact.
